# War Scroll Column 10 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 10 | **Condition:** complete

---

**10:1** "Who-is like-You, O God-of-Israel, in-the-heavens and on-the-earth? Who can-do like-Your-mighty-deeds and like-Your-great-strength?

**10:2** And who-is like-Your-people Israel, whom You-chose for-Yourself from-all the-peoples-of the-lands, a people-of the-holy-ones-of the-covenant, instructed in-the-law,

**10:3** enlightened in-understanding, hearing the-glorious-voice, seeing the-angels-of holiness, with ears-opened, and hearing deep-things and seeing the-formation-of the-luminaries?

**10:4** Who-has-measured the-expanse-of Your-wonders? And who-shall-recount-them? And the-counsel-of Your-glory — who-shall-attain-it?

**10:5** You created the-earth and the-laws-of its-divisions into-wilderness and plain, and all her-offspring with the-fruit-of the-ground.

**10:6** The circle-of the-seas and the-gathering-of the-rivers, the rift-of the-deeps, beasts and birds and the-form-of man, and the generations-of the-seed-of Adam,

**10:7** the-confusion-of tongues and the-division-of peoples, the-dwelling-of clans, the-inheritance-of lands, the sacred-appointed-times and the-cycle-of years and the-ages-of eternity.

**10:8** You created the-breath-of the-tongue; You-know its-words and You-established the-fruit-of the-lips before-they-came-to-be. You set-out words by-a-measuring-line and the breath-of the-lips by-measure.

**10:9** You brought-forth the-luminaries according-to their-mysteries, the-stars according-to the-paths-of their-courses, storm-winds according-to their-office, lightnings and thunders according-to their-service,

**10:10** the treasuries-of snow and the storehouses-of hail, and the-hoarfrost, and the-reservoir-of the-rains, the-dew and the-mist, the-form-of the-cloud, with the-light-of the-rainbow.

**10:11** The spirits-of the-holy-ones-of-truth and the-angels-of-wondrous-might serve before-You, and they-walk in-the-paths-of Your-glory. You-founded-them to-be mighty-ones for-Your-council.

**10:12** And the foundations-of the-world tremble at-Your-glory, and all Your-wondrous-mysteries — mighty-deeds in-Your-strength — they tremble before-You.

**10:13** Arise, O Hero! Take-Your-captives, O Glorious-One! Gather Your spoil, O Worker-of-valor! Set Your hand upon the-neck-of Your-enemies,

**10:14** and Your foot upon the-piles-of the-slain! Strike-the-nations, Your-adversaries, and let-Your-sword devour guilty-flesh!

**10:15** Fill Your-land with-glory and Your-inheritance with-blessing! An-abundance-of cattle in-Your-pastures, silver and gold and precious-stones in-Your-palaces!

**10:16** O Zion, rejoice greatly! Shine-forth in-songs-of-joy, O Jerusalem! And be-jubilant, all-you-cities-of Judah! Open your-gates continually

**10:17** that the-wealth-of the-nations may-be-brought-in to-you, and their-kings shall-serve-you, and all-your-oppressors shall-bow-down before-you, and the-dust-of your-feet they-shall-lick!"

---

*EMET notes: Column 10 is well preserved. This column is a sustained war hymn. Lines 1-4 echo the "Who is like You?" formula of Exodus 15:11. Lines 5-10 are a creation catalogue. Lines 11-12 describe the angelic court. Lines 13-17 shift to direct address of God as warrior, echoing Isaiah 60 and Zechariah 9:9 in the final jubilation.*
